operatorRuntimePrerequisites.requirement: Target host must enable the Cedros Wasm extension runtime and use the same cedros:extension WIT world.
Enable the host published encrypted extension-secret facility before configuring Stripe keys, webhook signing secrets, or other provider credentials.
Allowlist required HTTPS hosts such as api.stripe.com before enabling Stripe checkout, subscription, or webhook delivery egress.

Grant site storage, email, blockchain config, merchant x402 signing, policy-bound x402 refund signing, dedicated Site Assistant x402 signing, and optional intelligence provider access ids exactly as declared in providerAccess[].

Configure stripe.webhook_token as a random 64-character hexadecimal host secret and add ?token=TOKEN to the Stripe endpoint URL /extensions/cedros-pay/webhook/stripe. Pay authenticates the hint and retrieves the authoritative Event through site-scoped Stripe API credentials. Raw-body HMAC remains fail-closed on JSON-only hosts.

Publish and grant a policy-bound refund-signing capability before enabling new x402 refund execution. Pay never stores or loads a wallet private key; pending x402 refunds fail closed until this contract exists.

Publish and grant a policy-bound subscription collection-signing capability before enabling Solana subscription collection. Pay never stores or loads a collector private key; initial collection fails closed until this contract exists.

routeContracts.auth: Service-to-service bearer token. Caller must send Authorization: Bearer {cedros_pay_service_token}; the extension verifies it against the configured Pay relying-party shared secret before validating the batch.
routeContracts.requestSchema: HTTP POST JSON { batchId, items:[{ payoutId, affiliateUserId, payDestinationId, amount, currency }] } with Authorization: Bearer {cedros_pay_service_token} and Idempotency-Key: affiliate-payout-settlement:{batchId}. amount is integer atomic units.
routeContracts.responseSchema: HTTP 503 Cedros error envelope with code affiliate_payout_settlement_unavailable. Core operation storage exists, but the route never accepts work until Pay can validate stored destinations and execute the provider call.
routeContracts.validationRules: Requires exact Authorization bearer service token, exact Idempotency-Key prefix and batchId match, non-empty items, positive integer atomic amount, uppercase currency, and safe ASCII payout/batch/user/destination identifiers before failing closed because Pay payout execution is unavailable.
routeContracts.rateLimits: Host default service route bucket plus payout-settlement provider limits once provider execution is enabled.
routeContracts.idempotencyKeyStrategy: Request header must be affiliate-payout-settlement:{batchId}. No key is claimed while Pay lacks the destination and provider executor required to finish accepted work.
routeContracts.hostProviderCalls: Current route makes no provider calls and returns 503 before any payout side effect. Future settlement execution may call approved payout providers only after durable Core acceptance.
routeContracts.databaseCalls: Current route performs no database call. Cedros Data 0.1.10 offers durable payout operations, but Pay deliberately does not accept operations until its destination and provider executor can complete them.
routeContracts.analyticsSiteBrainLogs: No buyer PII, raw destination details, provider payloads, wallet private keys, or compliance details may be logged. Future settled payouts may emit redacted payout audit events only after durable Pay settlement state exists.
routeContracts.routeDiscovery: Host mounts route under /extensions/cedros-pay by routeId cedros-pay:admin-affiliate-payouts-settle.
routeContracts.rollbackBehavior: Unbind route; Affiliates must fail direct payout processing closed and leave payout rows queued for review. No funds move in the current fail-closed implementation.
routeContracts.launchGate: Core durable payout-operation acceptance plus Pay-owned destination storage, rail-specific validation, provider execution, and settlement persistence before returning any accepted or settled result.
routeContracts.failureMode: Fails closed with a retryable 503 after authentication and envelope validation; the relying party remains authoritative for the queued batch and no funds move.

routeContracts.auth: Requires authenticated Cedros admin context, admin-write CSRF proof, and cedros-pay:admin permission.
routeContracts.requestSchema: Path refundId; empty JSON body.
routeContracts.responseSchema: HTTP 200 durable state for an already-submitted or succeeded refund; HTTP 503 refund_signer_unavailable for a pending refund.
routeContracts.validationRules: Requires an x402 refund row. Existing submitted signatures may be polled and finalized; pending refunds never read key material, mutate state, or originate a transfer.
routeContracts.rateLimits: Host default admin mutation bucket plus configured Solana RPC limits for existing submitted signatures.
routeContracts.idempotencyKeyStrategy: Succeeded rows replay exactly; submitted rows re-poll the persisted signature and are never rebuilt.
routeContracts.hostProviderCalls: Reads blockchain RPC configuration and polls status only for an already-persisted submitted signature; no signing call or private-key access.
routeContracts.databaseCalls: Reads the Pay-owned refund/payment ledger and guarded-finalizes an existing submitted signature.
routeContracts.analyticsSiteBrainLogs: Emits only redacted refund transition outcomes; never wallet keys, raw transactions, or buyer identifiers.
routeContracts.routeDiscovery: Static Cedros Pay 5.0.8 fail-closed route.
routeContracts.rollbackBehavior: Disable new x402 refund processing while preserving pending/submitted ledger state for forward recovery.
routeContracts.launchGate: New x402 refund transfers are blocked until Cedros Wallet/Data publishes and grants a policy-bound refund signing contract.
routeContracts.failureMode: Pending refunds return refund_signer_unavailable without mutation; already-submitted signatures remain recoverable by exact status polling.

routeContracts.failureMode: Fails closed with zero enrolled models and no marker on any batch failure.
